readme.run: Register a cleared mouse brain stack to the Allen CCFv3 50 um atlas
notes: Input is a single-channel TIFF, OME-TIFF, folder of TIFF planes or OME-Zarr folder.
Pass --orientation CODE (e.g. psl) and --voxel-z/--voxel-y/--voxel-x when needed.
Add --detect to run cellfinder candidate detection; add --no-register for detection only.
The 50 um Allen Mouse Brain CCFv3 atlas is bundled in models/ for offline execution.
Research and noncommercial use only (Allen Institute terms of use).
Please cite Wang et al. 2020 (Allen CCFv3), Tyson et al. 2022 (brainreg),
Tyson et al. 2021 (cellfinder), and Yushkevich et al. (Greedy).
